# QuickKitAI / Raja AI Systems — Full Public Reference

> Canonical URL: https://quickkitai.com/llms-full.txt  
> Summary: https://quickkitai.com/llms.txt  
> Website: https://quickkitai.com  
> Last reviewed: 2026-11-16

## 1. Brand and service scope

Raja AI Systems is the public brand for managed AI-assisted business workflows and AI visibility / answer-engine optimisation (AEO) services. QuickKitAI is the platform and application name used in the existing product and repository.

The primary service focus is Indian real-estate builders, developers and brokerages. Healthcare is a secondary, project-scoped service for approved administrative workflows such as enquiry intake and appointment coordination. Clinical decisions remain with qualified healthcare professionals.

This document describes published service scope and offer information. It does not certify that every feature, provider integration or channel is enabled in every customer deployment.

## 2. AI visibility and AEO services

The AI Visibility service page describes evidence-led work across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI surfaces. Work starts with a baseline audit. Search rankings, AI citations, leads and revenue are measured outcomes, not guaranteed results.

### AI Visibility Audit

- Displayed offer: ₹9,999 one-time (regular reference price: ₹19,998).
- 30–50 buyer-intent prompts.
- Technical crawl and structured-data review.
- Competitor comparison.
- 30-day priority action plan.

### AI Visibility Monitor

- Displayed offer: ₹29,999 per month (regular reference price: ₹59,998).
- Up to 40 tracked prompts per month.
- Weekly or fortnightly checks.
- Mention and citation tracking.
- Competitor movement report and monthly executive summary.
- A baseline audit is required before recurring measurement begins.

### AI Visibility Growth

- Displayed offer: ₹75,000 setup + ₹1,20,000 per month (regular reference price: ₹1,50,000 setup + ₹2,40,000 per month).
- Includes the Monitor scope.
- Up to 60 tracked prompts per month.
- Up to 8 answer / FAQ work items per month.
- Up to 4 approved technical-fix batches per month.
- Staging implementation and re-audit.
- The onboarding baseline audit is included in the setup scope.

### Multi-location Enterprise

- Displayed offer: ₹2,50,000 setup + ₹2,00,000 per month (regular reference price: ₹5,00,000 setup + ₹4,00,000 per month).
- Custom prompt and location quotas.
- Separate location and prompt sets.
- Role-based approvals.
- Tenant-isolated evidence as a scoped deliverable, subject to deployment-specific authorization verification.
- Executive reporting and audits.
- The onboarding baseline audit is included in the setup scope.

The displayed offer prices, scope, eligibility, taxes, usage charges and availability must be reconfirmed against the current service page and written agreement before purchase.

## 3. Managed real-estate AI workforce

The separate managed-workforce offer describes a five-member workflow for real-estate teams.

- Reference pricing: ₹70,000 implementation setup + ₹2,40,000 per month.
- Pilot offer: ₹35,000 setup + ₹1,20,000 per month for up to 3 pilot clients.
- Third-party AI, API, messaging, telephony and other provider usage costs depend on the connected services and are not represented as included by default.

The public offer references a 12-second WhatsApp first-response target and a 30-day performance target of 10 qualified physical site visits for real estate or 15 qualified in-clinic consultations for healthcare. These are targets and conditional contractual terms, not historical performance claims or unconditional guarantees. Any measurement rules, qualifying traffic/access conditions and setup-fee refund trigger apply only when written into the current signed agreement.

### Five workflow roles

1. **WhatsApp first response and qualification** — voice-note and text workflow for initial enquiry handling. The 12-second figure is a response target, not a verified result for every account.
2. **Prospecting and competitor intelligence** — targeted public-business research and lead enrichment. The source-of-truth plan describes a maximum of 50 prospect dossiers per day; actual availability is subject to provider terms, lawful access and configured limits.
3. **CRM Sentinel and No-Show Guard** — appointment coordination, reminders, site-visit confirmation and CRM / human-sales handoff. This supports attendance workflows; it does not guarantee that no appointment will be missed.
4. **Dead Lead Reviver** — approved conversational reactivation workflows for dormant lead records.
5. **Reputation and Local SEO Sentinel** — feedback collection, review routing, escalation and local / AI-search visibility support.

### Typical workflow

Enquiry capture → qualification → follow-up → appointment or site-visit coordination → reminder and confirmation → CRM / human-sales handoff → approved dormant-lead reactivation → reputation follow-up.

The exact channels, operating hours, provider accounts, CRM actions, permissions, service windows and acceptance tests are scoped and verified for each deployment.

## 4. Integration and deployment requirements

A feature being described in the product does not mean its provider is connected or production-ready for every client. WhatsApp, CRM, calendar, email, voice, analytics and other external integrations require the relevant client or provider account, credentials, permissions, configuration, compliance review and end-to-end testing.

Managed deployment, monitoring and maintenance are scoped in the written agreement. Deployment-time estimates are targets, not unconditional delivery guarantees.

## 5. Measurement and evidence boundaries

- Record the prompt, date, search / AI surface, observed answer and supporting evidence when measuring AI visibility.
- Compare changes with a dated baseline and retain the measurement method.
- Label controlled demos, mock dashboards, sample counts and simulated agent events as illustrative.
- Do not present fabricated testimonials, simulated activity, unverified integrations or estimated outcomes as customer proof.
- Do not promise search rankings, AI citations, recommendations, leads, revenue or ROI.
- Treat performance figures as targets or signed contractual conditions unless dated operational evidence demonstrates an actual result.
